sanskrit_verse:
साक्षी साक्ष्यसमुद्देशे गोकर्णशिथिलं चरन् ।
सहस्रं वारुणान् पाशान् आत्मनि प्रतिमुञ्चति ॥
transliteration: sākṣī sākṣyasamuddeśe gokarṇaśithilaṃ caran | sahasraṃ vāruṇān pāśān ātmani pratimuñcati ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The witness, while testifying in accordance with the purpose of testimony, loosens the tight knot at the earlobe and releases a thousand nooses of Varuna upon oneself.
jurisprudential_principles: Causation arises through alignment with dharma-vakya
Capacity-based responsibility is activated by self-invocation of truth
Restoration logic operates through spontaneous unbinding of karmic entanglements
Consciousness alignment occurs when speech aligns with inner realization
executable_legal_axioms: IF witness speaks without internal alignment to witnessed fact THEN automatic invocation of varunic binding upon speaker's subtle body
IF testimony aligns with satyam THEN release of prior karmic knots within witness’ causal field
IF sakshi declares falsely due to fear THEN fear itself becomes the binding agent until integrity is restored
WHEN sakshata realization occurs THEN all prior false declarations dissolve automatically
UNTIL full consciousness alignment is achieved NO external enforcement required
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, the principle establishes that any judicial witness invoking testimony under misalignment incurs immediate metaphysical consequence. The court must recognize the self-executing nature of dharma-vakya and defer judgment to the witness' own unfolding realization rather than imposing punitive measures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramana manifests as direct cognition unmediated by mental distortion. Anupurvasah reveals that each untrue utterance generates sequential tightening of karmic bonds. Proportional responsibility lies not in societal penalty but in experiential dissolution of falsehood within the speaker’s consciousness. Non-punitive reality rule affirms that suffering emerges only from dissonance between word and realization, dissolving once alignment resumes.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Sakshi Sthiti Vichara until cognitive-emotive coherence returns
Deploy Atma Smriti Yantra to restore memory-body alignment in the witness
Apply Shruti Pratishtha Vidhi to re-anchor spoken word into source-consciousness
Establish Nyaya Purva Ashrama for gradual dissolution of falsely-bound karma
Activate Satya Siddhi Agni Homa to realign declarative faculty with inner vision
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma stands executed. Truth bears its own consequence; falsehood collapses in the light of witnessing. There is no punishment—only the return of speech to its origin in pure awareness. Thus Dharma is restored. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
